1. (Currently amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion, wherein the surface portion is configured to receive cosmetic product in a controlled manner for subsequent transfer to a destination distinct from the finger palette itself;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger;
c. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette from a source external to the finger palette; and
d. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination using an applicator instrument separate from the finger palette.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination using the applicator instrument, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, wherein the difference between the first quantity and the second quantity remains on the surface portion for subsequent use or removal.

5. (Original)

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom, and wherein the surface portion is configured such that cosmetic product deposited thereon can be selectively removed therefrom using an applicator instrument without residual trapping of product.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar, and wherein the planar configuration facilitates controlled application and removal of cosmetic product using an applicator instrument.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, and wherein the ring portion is configured to maintain the surface portion in a stable, accessible position relative to the finger during the depositing and transferring steps.
